import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source data
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: user ratings data
    # Schema: ['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp']
    df_ratings = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    df_ratings = df_ratings.astype({
        'user_id': 'int64',
        'item_id': 'int64',
        'rating': 'int64',
        'timestamp': 'int64'
    })

    # Load Source 1: movie metadata
    # Schema includes 'item_id' and 'movie title' among others
    df_movies = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Keep only 'item_id' and 'movie title' columns
    df_movies = df_movies[['item_id', 'movie title']]
    # Ensure 'item_id' is integer and 'movie title' is string
    df_movies['item_id'] = df_movies['item_id'].astype('int64')
    df_movies['movie title'] = df_movies['movie title'].astype(str)

    # Merge ratings with movie titles on 'item_id'
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_ratings, df_movies, on='item_id', how='left')

    # Check for any missing movie titles after merge (optional)
    missing_titles = df_merged['movie title'].isna().sum()
    if missing_titles > 0:
        print(f"Warning: {missing_titles} ratings have no matching movie title.")

    # Reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'movie title']
    df_target = df_merged[['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'movie title']]

    # Save the transformed data to the target CSV file
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
